features.name: Project bootstrap
features.description: Initialize package.json, TypeScript config, pnpm workspace, and install the `skills` dependency
features.evidence: package.json, tsconfig.json, pnpm-workspace.yaml, .prettierrc created; pnpm install succeeds; skills package resolves with all exports (resolveSource, installSkills, listSkills, removeSkills)

features.name: Core modules
features.description: manifest.ts (zod schema), lockfile.ts, resolve.ts, hash.ts, secrets.ts under src/core
features.evidence: manifest.ts (zod schema), lockfile.ts (read/write/verify, sorted keys, atomic writes, version errors), resolve.ts (fetch collection.json at ref -> commit SHA), hash.ts (manifestHash SHA-256), secrets.ts (pre-publish scanner); pnpm typecheck clean

features.name: skills adapter
features.description: src/skills/ wrapper isolating the `skills` dependency (resolveSource, installSkills, listSkills, removeSkills)

features.name: git wrappers
features.description: Thin shell wrappers around git under src/git/
features.evidence: src/git/index.ts: git(), resolveRef(), showFileAtCommit(), cloneRepo(); pnpm typecheck clean

features.name: cli.ts entry
features.description: Command dispatch with --yes and --json support for all commands
features.evidence: src/cli.ts implements main() with command dispatch; --yes/--json/--debug flags; npx tsx src/cli.ts --help and add --help both work

features.name: add command
features.description: Fetch collection.json, install member skills via skills, write kitcrate-lock.json
features.evidence: src/commands/add.ts: resolveCollection, preexisting detection, install via skills, write kitcrate-lock.json with sorted keys; typecheck clean

features.name: list command
features.description: Show installed collections and their skills from kitcrate-lock.json
features.evidence: src/commands/list.ts: reads lockfile, lists collections with member skills, --json support; typecheck clean

features.name: install, update, remove commands
features.description: install: restore from lockfiles + verify manifestHash; update: re-resolve ref + diff manifests; remove: ownership rules
features.evidence: src/commands/install.ts, update.ts, remove.ts all implemented; typecheck clean

features.name: validate and create commands
features.description: Check collection.json and referenced skills; publish flow with secret scan
features.evidence: src/commands/validate.ts: validate collection.json + skill references; src/commands/create.ts: skill discovery via the skills CLI adapter, publish gate (writes .gitignore, stages only collection.json+.gitignore+selected skill folders, unstages credential files, scans tracked content, blocks on credential-bearing history, refuses a dirty index), secret scan, git init/commit/tag, gh repo create; typecheck clean

features.name: Tests and verification
features.description: Unit tests for core modules; integration tests with local bare git repos and mocked gh
features.evidence: vitest configured; 67 unit and integration tests pass (manifest, lockfile, hash, secrets, gitignore, name normalization, skill discovery, create publish flow with a gh stub on PATH); pnpm typecheck clean; pnpm lint clean; pnpm build clean

features.name: Collection name normalization
features.description: Parse author-entered collection names into the lowercase-hyphen convention; unsupported characters raise the convention error
features.evidence: src/core/name.ts exports normalizeCollectionName returning a discriminated union (ok/name/changed or ok/reason); trims, lowercases, collapses whitespace runs and edge hyphens, rejects characters outside [a-z0-9-] with a message naming them; the collection.json schema is unchanged; 14 unit tests in test/name.test.ts

features.name: Interactive skill picker
features.description: Multi-select of discovered skills in create: space toggles, Enter finalizes; non-interactive runs select every skill
features.evidence: src/commands/create.ts uses @clack/prompts text/select/confirm/multiselect; every prompt handles cancellation (exit 130); the picker lists every discovered skill with its description and starts fully selected; --yes/--json/non-TTY skip the prompts and select all; verified in a pty that space toggles an entry off and Enter commits only the remaining skills

features.name: skills CLI discovery reuse
features.description: Replace kitcrate's hand-rolled skill scan and frontmatter parser with the skills CLI's own discovery
features.evidence: src/skills/index.ts exports discoverSkillsInDirectory built on resolveSource; the hand-rolled scanSkillDirectories/walkDirectory/readSkill are gone from create.ts; the adapter's isSkillsDiagnostic guard was fixed (the upstream isDiagnostic(error) with no codes always returned false) so an empty directory yields [] instead of escaping as a diagnostic; 4 discovery tests in test/create.test.ts

features.name: Secrets never block a publish
features.description: Secret findings are reported but never stop a publish; credential files stay excluded from the commit
features.evidence: src/commands/create.ts reports secret-pattern findings in the files that would be pushed and publishes anyway; credential files are still unstaged from the commit so they are never published; a credential file already in git history now produces a warning instead of a block; --allow-secrets is accepted as a no-op so older scripts keep working; 3 new tests in test/create.test.ts cover the publish-with-a-secret, the credential exclusion, and the history warning

features.name: Picker presentation
features.description: Skill list shows names only; each row shows an empty box that becomes a green tick when ticked
features.evidence: src/commands/pick-skills.ts builds on @clack/core's MultiSelectPrompt for the keyboard handling and draws the list itself, because clack hardcodes its checkbox symbols; every box starts empty (initialValues is empty) and the header shows the running count; verified in a pty that an unticked row renders a dim empty box (ESC[2m), a ticked row a green tick (ESC[32m), that descriptions are gone, that the list scrolls in a short terminal, and that confirming with nothing ticked exits 1 without publishing
